excerpt:
fn rejects_everything_outside_the_subset() {
    for src in [
        // macros, has(), matches, arithmetic, size, ternary, bytes, uint
        "object.tags.exists(t, t == 'x')",
        "object.tags.all(t, t == 'x')",
        "has(object.n)",
        "object.code.matches('a.*')",
        "object.n + 1 > 2",
        "size(object.code) > 0",
        "object.a == 'x' ? true : false",
        "object.b == b'x'",
        "object.n == 1u",
        // same-row restriction
        "principal.id == 'x'",
        "principal.groups == 'x'",
        "principal.attrs.undeclared == 'x'",
        "object.missing == 'x'",
        "request.ip == '1'",
        "object == 'x'",
        "object.a.b == 'x'",
        // types
        "object.n == 1.5",
        "object.d == 1",
        "object.n == 'x'",
        "object.when > '2026-01-01'",
        "object.cost == '1.0'",
        "object.day < 'x'",
        "object.location == null",
        "object.region in ['a', null]",
        "object.region in ['a', 1]",
        "object.n in [1, 2.5]",
        "object.region in principal.attrs.tenantId",
        "object.region in principal.attrs.nums",
        "object.n.startsWith('1')",
        "'abc'.startsWith('b')",
        "object.code.startsWith(object.a)",
        "object.code.startsWith(1)",
        "object.flag < true",
        "object.n < null",
        "null == null",
        "principal.attrs.regions == 'eu'",
        "object.tags == 'x'",
        // a bare operand is not a predicate
        "object.flag",
        "object.n",
    ] {
        let issues = compile(src).expect_err(src);
        assert_eq!(issues.len(), 1, "{src}: {issues:#?}");
        assert!(issues[0].pos.is_some(), "{src}: {issues:#?}");
    }
}

excerpt:
async fn audit_insert_failure_rolls_back_scope_and_indexes() {
    let f = fixture().await;
    let plan =
        f.t.store
            .scope_plan(&f.scope, &f.props)
            .await
            .expect("plan");
    let pool = f.t.side_pool().await;
    sqlx::query(
        "CREATE TRIGGER reject_admin_audit BEFORE INSERT ON of_admin_audit BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'audit unavailable'); END",
    )
    .execute(&pool)
    .await
    .expect("failure injection");

    let error =
        f.t.store
            .scope_apply(&f.scope, &f.props, &plan.hash, ACTOR)
            .await
            .expect_err("audit insertion must fail the whole apply");
    assert!(error.to_string().contains("audit unavailable"), "{error}");
    assert_eq!(count(&f.t, "of_role").await, 0);
    assert_eq!(count(&f.t, "of_role_binding").await, 0);
    assert_eq!(count(&f.t, "of_admin_audit").await, 0);
    let index_count: i64 = sqlx::query_scalar(
        "SELECT count(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'index' AND name = 'of_ix_of_obj_flight_departure_airport_code'",
    )
    .fetch_one(&pool)
    .await
    .expect("index lookup");
    assert_eq!(index_count, 0, "index DDL must roll back with scope");
    assert_eq!(
        f.t.store.load_scope().await.expect("scope"),
        ScopeSet::default()
    );
}

async fn sqlite_and_postgres_link_reads_match() {
    let (sqlite, pg, s_active, p_active) = pair().await;
    assert_eq!(
        sqlite
            .store
            .read_link_edits(&s_active, &link(), LinkEndpoint::From(s("A")), None, 2)
            .await
            .unwrap(),
        pg.store
            .read_link_edits(&p_active, &link(), LinkEndpoint::From(s("A")), None, 2)
            .await
            .unwrap(),
    );
    assert_eq!(
        sqlite
            .store
            .read_link_edits(
                &s_active,
                &link(),
                LinkEndpoint::To(PropertyValue::Int(2)),
                None,
                2
            )
            .await
            .unwrap(),
        pg.store
            .read_link_edits(
                &p_active,
                &link(),
                LinkEndpoint::To(PropertyValue::Int(2)),
                None,
                2
            )
            .await
            .unwrap(),
    );
}
